==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
Induced lucidity with my sleep paralysis technique. I wanted to hide the Death Staff off world. (The Death Staff resembles a wooden staff that crackles with purple lightning.) (This dream is a part of a recurring lucid dream continuity that started on 06/11/2025.) (This dream takes place in the Elven Village which resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees. )
The Elven Guard did not approve and I was escorted to the Village King. (The Village King is a giant, wooden, elf man who wears a green robe with a white fur collar.) (The Elven Guard wear badges that resemble a wooden circle, with a silver trim, marked with a green spiral.)
The Village King now has the Death Staff, but I don't trust him. (I don't know much about him. He seems powerful, which makes me wonder why he hasn't gotten involved until now.)
